name: Minoan Palatial Centres
description: On the Greek island of Crete, six Bronze Age sites preserve the great building complexes of the Minoans, who flourished here between roughly 1900 and 1100 BCE. Multistory wings ringed open central courtyards, holding workshops, shrines and huge storerooms for farm surpluses. Visitors can still see colourful frescoes, and clay tablets show the Minoans kept records and traded across the sea.
